services.name: Shrubs and hedges
services.blurb: Podocarpus, viburnum and firebush in 3- and 7-gallon pots, sorted by how much sun they need.

services.name: Trees that stand up to storms
services.blurb: Live oak, magnolia and sabal palm in sizes we can deliver, with mature height on every tag.

services.name: Citrus and fruit trees
services.blurb: Citrus, avocado and mango trees for Polk County yards, with the freeze nights to watch for.

services.name: Florida native plants
services.blurb: Coontie, muhly grass and beautyberry that live on sand once roots are down.

services.name: Annuals and hanging baskets
services.blurb: Cool-season color for October to March and heat-proof picks for the wet summer.

services.name: Succulents and cactus
services.blurb: Agave, aloe and pot-sized cactus for the hot spot by the driveway or the pool cage.

services.name: Houseplants
services.blurb: Low-light and bright-window houseplants, each labelled with the window it needs.

services.name: Soil, mulch and pots
services.blurb: Planting mix that holds water in sand, pine bark mulch and glazed pots by size.

services.name: Delivery and planting
services.blurb: Plants delivered and set in, watered in, with a printed watering plan for the first month.

services.name: Yard check by photo
services.blurb: Text us a photo of the spot and its sun hours, and get a short plant list back.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Used the sun-hours check before driving over. The side yard only gets about four hours, which explained why the last hibiscus never bloomed. Walked out with three plants on the list and they are all flowering.
reviews.name: Charmaine L.

reviews.text: After the storm took our laurel oak, we wanted a tree that would not end up on the roof. They showed mature size and wind notes on each tag. Live oak planted in November, staked and doing fine.
reviews.name: Buck H.
reviews.service: Trees that stand up to storms

reviews.text: Price ranges were on the website, so no surprise at the register. Forty podocarpus for a privacy hedge, delivered, planted along the fence and watered in. The watering sheet they left is on my fridge.
reviews.name: Reggie F.

reviews.text: Texted a photo of my Meyer lemon with curled leaves. Got an answer the same afternoon: leafminer, not a disease, leave it alone. Fruit set fine.
reviews.name: Ximena P.

reviews.text: Pure sand in our backyard. They sold me the planting mix and told me how wide to dig, not just how deep. The coontie and muhly have filled in after one rainy season.
reviews.name: Yusuf A.

reviews.text: I kill houseplants. Each one here has a card that says which window it wants. Pothos and a snake plant in my north-facing office, both alive four months later, which is a record for me.
reviews.name: Dolores K.

proof.guarantee: Trees and shrubs we plant are replaced once if they fail in the first 12 months.

prices.note: by number of plants and distance
